title: Jurassic World Rebirth
description: Time to join the past with the present, enjoy a world filled with these dinosaurs!
body:
![Jurassic World Rebirth Header](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/JURASSIC_WORLD_REBIRTH/MP_JURASSIC_WORLD_REBIRTH_Header.webp)
[![Jurassic World Rebirth Bisecthosting](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/JURASSIC_WORLD_REBIRTH/MP_JURASSIC_WORLD_REBIRTH_Promo.webp)](https://tinyurl.com/amy67484)
![Jurassic World Rebirth Description](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/JURASSIC_WORLD_REBIRTH/MP_JURASSIC_WORLD_REBIRTH_Overview.webp)
---
**Jurassic World Rebirth** is a dinosaur and technology themed modpack, integrating the past with the present. Designed for players who want to bring back a prehistoric world, this modpack is stuffed full of technology, decoration and more! This modpack focuses on a wide array of themes, with the ever present technology, bountiful decoration blocks and tools and most import the prehistoric beasts from 65 million blocks ago. So what are you waiting for? Jump into your new adventure today!

---
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/i82KzMG8WGQ?si=b2kByavFcYNUm8dg" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

![Jurassic World Rebirth Features](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/JURASSIC_WORLD_REBIRTH/MP_JURASSIC_WORLD_REBIRTH_Features.webp)
---
- [🥝] **Foodies** - So much food, nothing says you have to eat the same meal twice.
- [🏝️] **Biomes** - New Biomes in the Overworld, The Nether, The End and other Dimensions!
- [🦖] **Dinosaurs** - It's time to bring back our prehistoric pals; fossils, dna, machines and more await you in your revival process.
- [⚙️] **Tech** - Don't just pal around in the past, use modern machinery to make your life easier, why go mining when you can setup your own quarry.
- [🧸] **Decorations** - Time to pack your tools, with over 500+ unqiue decoration blocks and a variety of tools, enjoy decorating your enclosures until your heart is content.

---
